title: TSMC and Synopsys Bring cuLitho to Production
body: NVIDIA announced TSMC and Synopsys are going into production with NVIDIA's cuLitho computational lithography platform, accelerating manufacturing and reducing costs, space and power by replacing 40,000 CPU systems with 350 H100 systems.

context.text: TSMC and NVIDIA Transform Semiconductor Manufacturing With Accelerated Computing
why: cuLitho entering production with TSMC materially improves NVIDIA's ability to manufacture advanced chips faster and cheaper at scale.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA announces Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin
body: At GTC 2025 on March 18, 2025, NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipping second half 2025, Vera Rubin for 2026, Feynman for 2028, and Dynamo inference software.

context.text: NVIDIA Expands AI Dominance With New Chips: Should You Buy the Stock?
why: NVIDIA defined its multi-year AI compute roadmap with next-gen architectures that reset product and revenue expectations.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA invests $5B in Intel
body: NVIDIA announced a $5 billion investment in Intel common stock at $23.28 per share and a collaboration to develop custom AI data center and PC products using NVLink.

context.text: Intel vs. Lattice Semiconductor: Which AI Chip Stock is a Better Buy?
why: NVIDIA's $5B investment in Intel creates a strategic CPU alliance that diversifies its supply and product roadmap against export risks.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA and OpenAI announce 10 gigawatt partnership
body: NVIDIA and OpenAI announced a letter of intent to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure, with NVIDIA intending to invest up to $100 billion progressively as each gigawatt is deployed.

context.text: VTI ETF Investment Analysis and Market Outlook
why: NVIDIA committed hardware and financial guarantees to a $500B OpenAI data center expansion that will significantly expand its AI infrastructure outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA launches Newton and Isaac GR00T N1.6
body: NVIDIA announced the open-source Newton Physics Engine in Isaac Lab and the open Isaac GR00T N1.6 reasoning vision language action model as part of an accelerated robotics platform.

context.text: Nvidia Smashes 52-Week High As Robots And AI Take Off - NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVDA )
why: NVIDIA launched a unified open-source robotics platform that expands its addressable market into humanoid robot training and deployment.
date evidence (day)

title: US allows Nvidia H200 chip exports to China
body: On December 8, 2025, President Trump announced the US would allow Nvidia H200 AI chip exports to China with a 25% fee, and ByteDance and Alibaba later showed interest in ordering them.

context.text: Alibaba Stock (BABA) Before the Market Opens Dec. 26, 2025: Latest News, AI Chip Catalysts, Key Risks, and Analyst Targets
why: The U.S. export approval reopened a major closed market, materially expanding NVIDIA's addressable AI chip demand in China.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia makes Vera CPU available standalone
body: Nvidia announced its Vera CPU would be available as a standalone offering with CoreWeave as the first customer, targeting a $200B CPU market with nearly $20B CPU revenue visibility in 2026.

context.text: Nvidia has a $200 Billion Warning for AMD and Intel Stock Investors
why: Launching the standalone Vera server CPU opens a $200B market and diversifies NVIDIA beyond GPUs with a $20B FY2027 target.
date evidence (day)

title: China approves 400,000 H200 chip purchase
body: China approved ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent to purchase more than 400,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips in total.

context.text: Alibaba Backed Moonshot AI Upgrades Its Flagship Model, Claims to Outdo US Rival AI Models
why: China authorized a 400,000-unit H200 purchase, materially reopening a major market NVIDIA had been locked out of.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3 Super, $26B open-AI bet
body: NVIDIA released the Nemotron 3 Super open-weight model and confirmed a planned $26 billion over five years for open-source AI models to counter Chinese models like Qwen.

context.text: Nvidia Drops Nemotron 3 Super Amid $26 Billion Open-Model AI Bet-America's Answer to Qwen?
why: The $26B open-AI commitment and Nemotron 3 Super launch reshaped NVIDIA's open-source AI strategy.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Unveils Vera Rubin Platform at GTC 2026
body: NVIDIA announced the Vera Rubin platform with Rubin GPU and Vera CPU at GTC 2026 on March 16, 2026, with shares closing up 1.6% per Reuters.

context.text: Nvidia GTC 2026 Kicks Off in San Jose, Igniting a Tech-Wide Rally as 'Rubin' Architecture and Physical AI Take Center Stage
why: Unveiling Vera Rubin set NVIDIA's next-gen AI architecture roadmap and lifted its shares materially.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia sees $1T Blackwell and Rubin orders through 2027
body: At GTC 2026, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he sees at least $1 trillion in purchase orders for Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems through 2027.

context.text: BlackRock’s Larry Fink Says AI Is Creating a New Trillion Dollar Asset Class — And Trump’s Policies May Accelerate It
why: Securing ~$1T in Blackwell and Vera Rubin orders through 2027 cemented multi-year revenue visibility amid severe compute shortages.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 revenue beats at $81.6B
body: NVIDIA reported Q1 FY27 revenue of $81.6 billion beating estimates, announced an $80 billion buyback and dividend hike with data center revenue of $75.2 billion up 92% from a year ago.

context.text: Nvidia earnings live updates: The key numbers to watch for in the report
why: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of $81.6B and $80B buyback confirmed explosive AI demand and returned massive capital to shareholders.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin enters full production
body: NVIDIA announced at GTC Taipei on May 31, 2026 that its third-generation Vera Rubin MGX rack-scale platform is ramping into full production with production shipments set to begin this fall.

context.text: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ramps Into Full Production to Power Agentic AI Factories Worldwide - NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVD
why: Vera Rubin entering full production marks the start of NVIDIA's next-gen AI platform shipments, reshaping its data center revenue base.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA unveils RTX Spark superchip
body: NVIDIA unveiled the RTX Spark superchip at GTC Taipei on May 31, 2026, a MediaTek-collaborated Arm-based chip running Windows on Arm with laptops and desktops from Dell, Lenovo and others shipping this fall.

context.text: Nvidia Enters Windows Laptop Market, Taking On Intel and AMD
why: NVIDIA entered the Windows PC chip market with RTX Spark, opening a new $200B CPU segment beyond its GPU base.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA anchors $10B Helix AI infrastructure launch
body: NVIDIA partnered with KKR, Vistra, and the Kuwait Investment Authority to launch Helix Digital Infrastructure with over $10 billion in committed capital for hyperscaler AI infrastructure.

context.text: KKR, Nvidia, Vistra, Kuwait Investment Authority launch infrastructure company for hyperscalers
why: NVIDIA's anchor role in KKR's $10B Helix AI infrastructure fund extends its business model into owned AI data-center build-out.
date evidence (day)
